high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Wired.com, dated June 2005. The content discusses the impact and spread of a speech given by Steve Jobs at Stanford University. The text highlights that at the time, YouTube was only months old, Twitter did not exist, and Facebook had not yet established its news feed. National media had not covered the speech, and Apple had not issued press releases. However, Stanford published the transcript on its website, which led to the speech gaining widespread attention.
